item.title: How Much Did ‘The Devil Wears Prada 2’ Boost Soundtrack Songs by Lady Gaga & Doechii, Madonna and Dua Lipa?
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. We're diving into the latest trends and hits that are taking the music industry by storm.
[Short music transition]
Host: First up, the sequel to the 2006 hit movie "The Devil Wears Prada" is killing it at the box office, raking in $77 million domestically and $233 million globally. And its soundtrack is also seeing a significant boost. Lady Gaga's song "Runway" from the movie has gained 189% in streams, reaching nearly 2.2 million streams over the release weekend. Other songs featured in the movie, like Dua Lipa's "End of an Era" and Madonna's "Vogue", are also seeing significant increases in streams.
[Short music transition]
Host: Next, we're taking a trip down memory lane to 2016. Mac Miller and Ty Dolla $ign's song "Cinderella" is experiencing a massive surge in popularity, thanks to TikTok. The song has been used in over 2.2 million clips, with users expressing their love and connection to the song. As a result, "Cinderella" has jumped into the top 10 of Hot Rap Songs, over 10 years after its initial release.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for this week's update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time with more music news and trends. [Outro music continues to play]
